entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Ancient elder dragon planeswalker whose nefarious schemes drive the Conflux story.

entities.name: Malfegor
entities.description: Spawn of a demon and a dragon, Bolas's right-hand general on Grixis and the killer of the archangel Asha.

entities.name: Asha
entities.description: Ruler title of Bant's angels; the last angel to hold it died at Malfegor's hands during the splitting of Alara.

entities.name: Gwafa Hazid
entities.description: Ambitious, morally flexible merchant-master of Bant's Grand Caravan, with a part in Bolas's plans.

entities.name: Rakka Mar
entities.description: Potent elementalist and servant of Bolas who may one day fill Jund with her elementals.

entities.name: Progenitus
entities.description: Hydra-god that elven creation myths call the soul of all Alara.

entities.name: Child of Alara
entities.description: Bizarre spawn of the Maelstrom that emerges to wreak havoc on the plane.

entities.name: Crucius
entities.description: Brilliant sphinx artificer who devised etherium and was indirectly spurned because of the aether-liches.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: The plane that was split into five shards and is now coming back together.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: Shard of Alara with a Grand Caravan, an Order of the Reliquary and an empty throne of Asha.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: Shard of Alara where Malfegor is Bolas's right-hand general.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: Shard of Alara where goblins are dragon chow and Rakka Mar may build an army.

entities.name: Order of the Skyward Eye
entities.description: Doomsayers who act as Bolas's minions, spreading paranoia throughout Bant.

entities.name: Order of the Reliquary
entities.description: Bant order that scours ruins for relics; after the Conflux it explores beyond Bant's borders.

entities.name: The Conflux
entities.description: The coming together of the shards, with open war breaking out between adjacent shards and the rise of Bolas.

events.summary: The shards of Alara come together in the Conflux, open war breaks out between adjacent shards, and Nicol Bolas rises.
events.quote: Conflux is, of course, about the shards coming together, but also about open war breaking out between the "adjacent" shards

events.summary: Malfegor kills Asha, ruler of Bant's angels, during the splitting of Alara, leaving the throne empty.
events.quote: since she died at the hands of Malfegor during the splitting of Alara

events.summary: After the Conflux, the Order of the Reliquary is sent beyond Bant's borders to find Bant landmarks that emerged from other shards.
events.quote: After the Conflux their mission changes

events.summary: Bolas's minions in the Order of the Skyward Eye spread paranoia throughout Bant.
events.quote: Bolas's minions, the doomsayers from the Order of the Skyward Eye, spreading paranoia throughout Bant.

relations.note: Killed during the splitting of Alara.
